user.title: Reef ICP
user.description: Create an aquarium profile with net water volume, stocking profile and dosing system, then upload the first ICP PDF. After confirming it, you can add more existing ICP reports before the aquarium is created. Reef ICP detects the laboratory automatically and asks you to confirm it before import.
